cards.ex_en: Honesty is an important virtue.
cards.ex_cn: 诚实是一种重要的美德。

cards.ex_en: The heavy rain hindered our trip.
cards.ex_cn: 大雨妨碍了我们的行程。

cards.ex_en: The noise did not cease all night.
cards.ex_cn: 那噪音整晚都没停。

cards.ex_en: He thought about settling in the town.
cards.ex_cn: 他考虑在这个镇上定居。

cards.ex_en: I casually met an old friend today.
cards.ex_cn: 我今天偶然遇到一位老友。

cards.ex_en: She consulted the teacher about her plan.
cards.ex_cn: 她就自己的计划请教了老师。

cards.ex_en: The judge treated everyone justly.
cards.ex_cn: 法官公正地对待每个人。

cards.ex_en: They were overtaken by a sudden storm.
cards.ex_cn: 一场突来的暴风雨降临到他们头上。

cards.ex_en: It was only a capful of wind.
cards.ex_cn: 那只是一小阵风。

cards.ex_en: They drank a bowl of warm punch.
cards.ex_cn: 他们喝了一碗温热的潘趣酒。

cards.ex_en: He looked calm and unconcerned.
cards.ex_cn: 他看上去镇定又毫不担心。

cards.ex_en: In the first hurries no one knew what to do.
cards.ex_cn: 在最初的慌乱中没人知道该怎么办。

cards.ex_en: The storm broke two of the ship's masts.
cards.ex_cn: 暴风雨折断了船上两根桅杆。

cards.ex_en: It was apparent that he was tired.
cards.ex_cn: 很明显他累了。

cards.ex_en: The rock staved a hole in the boat.
cards.ex_cn: 礁石在船上撞破了一个洞。

cards.ex_en: He gave me many assurances of help.
cards.ex_cn: 他向我做出许多帮助的保证。

cards.ex_en: She grew agitated while waiting for news.
cards.ex_cn: 等消息时她变得焦躁不安。

cards.ex_en: I owe my success to my teacher.
cards.ex_cn: 我把成功归功于我的老师。

cards.ex_en: People trust him for his integrity.
cards.ex_cn: 人们因他的正直而信任他。

cards.ex_en: Water was pouring into the boat.
cards.ex_cn: 水正涌进船里。

cards.ex_en: The sailors ran across the wet decks.
cards.ex_cn: 水手们跑过湿滑的甲板。

cards.ex_en: He was hacking at the thick branch.
cards.ex_cn: 他正猛砍那根粗树枝。

cards.ex_en: They plied the enemy with arrows.
cards.ex_cn: 他们向敌人连连放箭。

cards.ex_en: The cat is quick and nimble.
cards.ex_cn: 这只猫又快又灵活。

cards.ex_en: The ship went out on a long cruise.
cards.ex_cn: 那艘船出海进行长途巡航。

cards.ex_en: They were fitting out the ship for a voyage.
cards.ex_cn: 他们正为航行装备这艘船。

cards.ex_en: He visits us oftener than before.
cards.ex_cn: 他比以前更常来看我们。

cards.ex_en: It rained hard, insomuch that we stayed home.
cards.ex_cn: 雨下得很大,以致我们待在家里。

cards.gloss_cn: 费力干、吃力地做(labour过去式)
cards.ex_en: They laboured all day in the field.
cards.ex_cn: 他们在田里辛苦干了一整天。

cards.ex_en: He conveyed the boxes to the boat.
cards.ex_cn: 他把箱子搬到船上。

cards.ex_en: She made a candle out of beeswax.
cards.ex_cn: 她用蜂蜡做了一支蜡烛。

cards.ex_en: A southerly wind pushed the ship north.
cards.ex_cn: 一阵南风把船推向北方。

cards.ex_en: The captain stood at the helm.
cards.ex_cn: 船长站在舵旁掌舵。

cards.ex_en: He used his wits to escape.
cards.ex_cn: 他用机智逃脱了。

cards.ex_en: The howlings of wild beasts filled the night.
cards.ex_cn: 野兽的嚎叫声充满了夜晚。

cards.gloss_cn: 派遣;结果掉、杀死(dispatch过去式)
cards.ex_en: He despatched the wounded beast with one shot.
cards.ex_cn: 他一枪结果了那头受伤的野兽。

cards.ex_en: He was glad to oblige his new friends.
cards.ex_cn: 他很乐意帮新朋友的忙。

cards.ex_en: She is charitable to the poor.
cards.ex_cn: 她对穷人很慷慨仁慈。

cards.ex_en: I was loth to leave my home.
cards.ex_cn: 我不情愿离开自己的家。

cards.ex_en: He faithfully kept his promise.
cards.ex_cn: 他忠实地信守了诺言。

cards.ex_en: He signed an obligation to pay the money.
cards.ex_cn: 他签了一份付款的契约。

cards.ex_en: The train arrived punctually at nine.
cards.ex_cn: 火车九点准时到达。

cards.ex_en: The sack weighed nearly a hundredweight.
cards.ex_cn: 那袋子重近一英担。

cards.ex_en: He left his money with a trusted agent.
cards.ex_cn: 他把钱交给一位可信的代理人。

cards.ex_en: His impetuosity often led to trouble.
cards.ex_cn: 他的鲁莽常常惹来麻烦。

cards.ex_en: They rowed the boat toward the shore.
cards.ex_cn: 他们把船划向岸边。

cards.ex_en: A pilot guided the ship into port.
cards.ex_cn: 一名领航员把船引入港口。

cards.ex_en: This is the room wherein he was born.
cards.ex_cn: 这就是他出生的那间屋子。

cards.ex_en: He sat by the fire, reflecting on his day.
cards.ex_cn: 他坐在火边,回想着这一天。

cards.ex_en: They found little sustenance on the island.
cards.ex_cn: 他们在岛上几乎找不到食物。
